title: Embedding Calibration Config v0.1
description: Turn P9: provider-neutral, bounded, Gold-blind calibration run configuration. Layered ON TOP of ../../retrieval/interfaces/embedding-config.schema.json (never modified) -- this schema governs BUDGET/SAFETY/AUTHORIZATION for a calibration run, while provider/model identity construction is still delegated to createEmbeddingAdapter via a derived EmbeddingConfig. provider_id/model_id/endpoint are free-text, config-only fields: no calibration code branches on their literal value.

calibration_id.description: Stable identifier for this exact calibration run configuration, used to join operational/quality telemetry back to a config without re-deriving it from free text.

adapter_kind.description: Maps 1:1 onto embedding-adapter.mjs's own EmbeddingConfig.kind -- reused, never re-implemented. FAKE_DETERMINISTIC never makes a network call regardless of actual_external_call_authorized.

provider_id.description: Free-text provider label for telemetry only. Never used to select a code branch.

model_id.description: Free-text embedding model label for telemetry only. Never hardcoded inside calibration/runner code.

endpoint.description: Required real content when adapter_kind=HTTP_EMBEDDINGS (the embeddings endpoint URL); a placeholder string is acceptable for FAKE_DETERMINISTIC, which never dereferences it.

maximum_item_count.description: Hard cap on how many calibration dataset items this run may ever process. Checked before the first embedding call is ever issued.

maximum_request_count.description: Hard cap on the total number of embedding requests (including retries) this run may ever issue.

maximum_total_input_units.description: Hard cap on total estimated input units (characters) summed across every item this run may ever submit.

sample_salt.description: Deterministic-sampling salt; the SAME salt against the SAME candidate pool always selects the SAME dataset.

dataset_manifest_sha256.description: Pins this config to one already-generated CalibrationDatasetManifest -- a config is never valid against an unpinned or different dataset.

api_key_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. Required when adapter_kind=HTTP_EMBEDDINGS UNLESS auth_mode is explicitly "NONE". The key value itself is never part of this config or of any telemetry/log/report output.

auth_mode.description: Turn P9.2. Absent means BEARER_ENV -- identical to every CalibrationConfig this schema has ever accepted before this Turn. NONE is only ever honored by the underlying EmbeddingConfig/adapter for a verified LOOPBACK endpoint hostname.

network_scope.description: Turn P9.2. Optional, informational self-declaration for manifests/telemetry only -- the adapter independently re-derives the real scope from the endpoint URL and never trusts this field for the auth_mode=NONE safety check.

server_pin.description: Turn P9.2. OPTIONAL. Absent means no preflight server-identity handshake runs (identical to every CalibrationConfig before this Turn). When present, runner.mjs performs exactly one GET to server_info_url before the first embedding POST and fails the run closed (zero POSTs) on any mismatch -- see runner.mjs's runServerIdentityHandshake.

cache_policy.description: When enabled, a text's embedding is requested at most once per run even if it appears more than once in the dataset (never persisted across runs -- in-memory only for this one run).

retryable_error_codes.description: Only these EmbeddingCallError codes are ever retried. EMBEDDING_CALL_MALFORMED_RESPONSE and EMBEDDING_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE are never retryable -- a malformed/missing-key failure will not resolve itself on a second attempt.

input_price_per_million_units.description: Real provider pricing is NEVER hardcoded in code -- when null, estimated_cost in the result is always null. When a number, estimated_cost = (input units actually submitted / 1,000,000) * this value.

actual_external_call_authorized.description: Must be exactly true for an HTTP_EMBEDDINGS adapter to ever be allowed to issue a request. FAKE_DETERMINISTIC never makes a network call regardless of this flag's value. Absent env-var API keys are never auto-used -- this flag is the ONLY authorization signal the runner accepts.
